The area of the circle is calculated using the formula \( A = \pi r^2 \).

1. Actual area: \( A = \pi (10)^2 = 100\pi \) cm².
2. Computed area when diameter is 24 cm (radius 12 cm): \( A' = \pi (12)^2 = 144\pi \) cm².
3. Computed area when diameter is 16 cm (radius 8 cm): \( A'' = \pi (8)^2 = 64\pi \) cm².

Calculating the percent errors:

1. For radius 12 cm: 
   \[
   \text{Percent error} = \left( \frac{|144\pi - 100\pi|}{|100\pi|} \right) \times 100\% = \left( \frac{44\pi}{100\pi} \right) \times 100\% = 44\%
   \]

2. For radius 8 cm:
   \[
   \text{Percent error} = \left( \frac{|64\pi - 100\pi|}{|100\pi|} \right) \times 100\% = \left( \frac{36\pi}{100\pi} \right) \times 100\% = 36\%
   \]

The largest possible percent error in the computed area is 44%.
